label: Generated load
definition: Generated load (p.e.), size of the agglomeration

label: Load collected
definition: Proportion of generated load of agglomeration collected through collecting system (% of the agglomeration size – `generatedLoad`). Article 3; Article 22(1)(b).

label: Load individual systems
definition: Proportion of generated load of agglomeration above 2000 p.e. addressed through Individual Systems - IS (% of the agglomeration size – `generatedLoad`). Article 4(5); Article 22(1)(c).

label: Load not collected
definition: Proportion of generated load of agglomeration not collected through collecting systems and not addressed through IS (% of the agglomeration size – `generatedLoad`)

label: Individual systems registry
definition: Individual systems that are used in agglomerations of 1 000 p.e. and above are registered in a registry. Article 4(3).

label: Management plan obligation
definition: MS shall establish a list of agglomerations obliged to have IUWMP (by 6/2028). Article 5.
